WeaponAddon_FrostforgedCrescent_Effect:
Basic attacks are fixed to the first slash. Basic and sheathed attacks all count as the final combo attack.
Every basic attack swing triggers your Scabbard of Exorcism regardless of its charge time.
The special attack becomes Sheathe. While sheathed, a frost glow surrounds you, movement speed is increased by 60% and sheathed attacks scale with attack speed.
Attacks from the sheathed stance also trigger the Scabbard of Exorcism, and your Voluspa fires along with it toward your aim.
Extra-trigger effects of Ice Armaments still apply.
Item_FFC_FrostBlade_FlavorText: A blade tempered in frost. Ceremonial, yet its edge is alive.
Item_FFC_ScoreNorthWind_FlavorText: The north wind made the Vikings.
Item_FFC_BloodstonePendant_FlavorText: Should a gem stained this red be allowed to be so beautiful?
Keyword_FFC_IceCrit: Critical chance of <tag=Elemental_Ice> attacks increased by {VALUE} (not applied to companion damage)
Keyword_FFC_WeaponToIce: Weapon attack damage is reduced by {VALUE}, but becomes based on <tag=IceDamage>.
Keyword_FFC_HealOnHit: Recover {VALUE} of max HP whenever you deal damage
Keyword_FFC_LastStand: Once per battle, when taking lethal damage, HP becomes 1 and you are invulnerable for 3 seconds
Keyword_FFC_MaxHpDamage: Weapon hits deal extra damage equal to {VALUE} of max HP (highest elemental damage)
ComboEffect_FFC_DarkCloudEmpty: Lightning still strikes for 50% damage while the dark cloud is empty
WeaponAddon_FFC_BlueBeetle_Effect:
Attack speed +20%. Weapon attacks have a 20% chance to inflict Frostbite.
Basic Attack: Thrust repeats only its 3rd, 4th and 5th hits.
On hit, your Völuspá fires toward the aim at half damage. It ignores Völuspá's charge time, and extra activations of ice armaments apply.
The special attack deals no damage and parries for 0.5s as its motion begins. A successful parry grants 3 Fury (up to 9).
With Fury, the special attack spends 1 Fury to use [Breakthrough]: dash toward the aim with a thrust (counts as a special attack), invincible until the dash ends.
EffectHUD_FFC_Fury_FlavorText: Power gained from a successful parry. Press the special attack to spend 1 and use [Breakthrough].
Item_FFC_FrostWingFeather_FlavorText: A feather of the divine beast that once guarded the north wind.
Item_FFC_Erindanua_FlavorText: It serves the Queen of Paradise.
Keyword_FFC_FuryGain: Gain {VALUE} extra Fury whenever you gain Fury
Keyword_FFC_LanceOnly: Frost Rider : Lance Blue Beetle only
WeaponAddon_FFC_Knight_Effect:
Attack speed +20%.
Basic Attack: Thrust repeats only its 3rd, 4th and 5th hits.
The special attack deals no damage and parries for 0.5s as its motion begins. A successful parry grants 3 Fury (up to 9).
With Fury, the special attack spends 1 Fury to use [Breakthrough]: dash toward the aim with a thrust, invincible until the dash ends.
[Breakthrough]: counts as a special attack
WeaponAddon_FFC_FlameRider_Effect:
Whenever you gain a Sun Sword, also gain 1 Flame Pinion, which ignores the Sun Sword cap.
Flame Pinions count as Sun Swords (used when Sun Swords run out) and deal 160% of fire damage.
With 20 or more Flame Pinions: attack speed +100%, burn stacks +3
Inherits every effect of Myriad Lance : Four Horsemen.
WeaponAddon_FFC_ThunderRider_Effect:
On hit, spends a dark cloud to strike; with no dark cloud, strikes with a 50% weakened one instead.
Every enemy hit by the weapon is struck, without limit.
When Cloudseed Arrowhead's empower chance exceeds 100%, the excess stacks as a damage multiplier (+1x per 100%).
Inherits every effect of Myriad Lance : Four Horsemen.
WeaponAddon_FFC_DoomRider_Effect:
Critical chance +20%, critical damage +50%
Weapon attacks deal [Cosmic] damage, calculated only from your Cosmic damage and independent of other elements.
Cosmic damage +40
Inherits every effect of Myriad Lance : Four Horsemen.
EffectHUD_FFC_Feather_FlavorText: Counts as a Sun Sword and is used when Sun Swords run out. At 20 or more: attack speed +100%, burn stacks +3.
